source.fonts: astro.config.mjs (Astro fonts API, fontsource provider: Bangers 400, Patrick Hand 400)
source.stack: Astro 7 + Tailwind v4, GSAP (ScrollTrigger, SplitText), Lenis

display.purpose: Cover title only; pink fill with a 2px ink text-stroke.

headline.purpose: Chapter and section headings; 3.75rem from 640px; back cover reaches 4.5rem with the pink-and-stroke treatment.

title.purpose: Case-file and role titles; roles rise to 2.25rem from 640px; group names at 1.5rem.

stat.purpose: By-the-numbers values in the panel accent; 3rem from 640px; 1.5px ink stroke and 3px ink drop shadow.

sfx.purpose: Sound-effect lettering in the panel accent; 2px ink stroke, 4px drop shadow, tilted -8deg; wide panel uses clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem).

button.purpose: All CTAs; small variants at 1.1rem (header, skip) and 1rem (resume dialog).

label.purpose: Menu captions (0.08em); file tabs at 0.06em; issue-number stickers at 0.85rem and 0.04em.

lede.purpose: One-line chapter intro, knocked out of the halftone with a cream background.

body.purpose: Base size for all reading text; bubbles run at 1.125rem to 1.25rem.

small.purpose: Metadata lines, consequence labels, footer; back-issue metadata at 0.75rem.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Panels and the chapters menu list.

shadows.name: panel-live
shadows.purpose: Resume sheet at rest; grows to 11px 11px on hover. Case files go from ink to 10px 10px 0 #ff2e63 on hover.

shadows.name: button
shadows.purpose: Every .btn at rest; shrinks to 2px 2px as the button presses.

shadows.name: sticker
shadows.purpose: Page-number tiles, badges, year circles, the chapters button (1px 1px on press); menu numbers at 2px 2px.

shadows.name: cover
shadows.purpose: Back-issue covers; lifts to 7px 7px 0 #ff2e63 on hover. Portrait 6px 6px 0 #111, avatar 4px 4px 0 #111.

shadows.name: lettering
shadows.purpose: Sound effects; stats use 3px 3px 0 #111. Always paired with an ink text-stroke.

shadows.name: dialog-backdrop
shadows.purpose: Resume dialog backdrop; the only blur besides the sticky header.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Buttons and the chapters button press into their shadow.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: Back-issue covers and the resume sheet lift with a growing pink shadow.

motion.name: scroll
motion.value: Lenis lerp 0.11; anchor scrollTo offset -80, duration 1.2
motion.purpose: Smooth scroll and in-page anchors; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: panel-arrive
motion.value: gsap.from y:50 scale:.97 0.6s back.out(1.4), ScrollTrigger top 96% once, clearProps transform
motion.purpose: Each non-cover panel slams in once; no rotation on panels.

motion.name: sfx-pop
motion.value: gsap.from scale:0 rotation:-30 0.8s elastic.out(1,.45), top 96% once
motion.purpose: Sound effects pop as they arrive.

motion.name: caption-stamp
motion.value: gsap.fromTo scaleX 0 to 1, origin left center, 0.45s power4.out, stagger .05, top 92% once
motion.purpose: Captions stamp in from the left.

motion.name: heading-letters
motion.value: SplitText chars gsap.from y:110% rotation:6 opacity:0 0.6s back.out(1.8) stagger .015, top 88% once
motion.purpose: Chapter headings letter in; cover title uses y:80 random rotation -14..14 back.out(2) stagger .03.

motion.name: bubble-spring
motion.value: gsap.from scale:.92 origin left bottom 0.55s back.out(1.6), top 96% once

motion.name: cover-sticker
motion.purpose: Edition burst spins in on load.

motion.name: halftone-drift
motion.purpose: The halftone drifts slowly with scroll.

motion.name: curtain
motion.value: scaleY 0 to 1 0.55s power4.inOut leaving; 1 to 0 0.7s on arrival; colour var(--curtain) #ff2e63
motion.purpose: Pink page curtain between same-origin routes; present but inert while the site has one route.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) animation: none; transition: none; both scripts gate on matchMedia
motion.purpose: All choreography, smooth scroll and the curtain are removed; content is unchanged.

borders.name: panel
borders.purpose: Panels, page numbers, menu list, portrait, avatar, dialog, header bottom edge.

borders.name: control
borders.purpose: Buttons, captions, bubbles, tiles, badges, file tabs, chapters button, covers.

borders.name: dashed-rule
borders.purpose: Separates a case file's detail and the back cover's channels.

borders.name: halftone
borders.purpose: The page stock; reused inside spot art as a 30-50% wash.

narrative.overview:
The site is a single comic book issue: a cover, chapters, and a back cover, printed on cream halftone stock. Everything on the page is material a comic artist would draw by hand with a thick ink pen: white panels with heavy black borders and hard offset shadows, yellow narration captions, speech bubbles with tails, sound-effect lettering with a drop shadow, file tabs and page-number tiles. There is no soft shadow and no tinted line; the only grey is a muted ink for secondary lines, the only blur sits behind the sticky header and the dialog, and the only gradients are hard-stop (the halftone dots, the dashed spine, the zig-zag band, the highlighter stripe). The ink is always #111, the paper is always white or cream, and colour is applied flat.

Density is generous and legible. Text is large (body starts at 1.1rem), panels carry a lot of air (1.5rem to 2.5rem of padding), and chapters are separated by 4rem of halftone. Bangers does all the shouting (headings, buttons, labels, stats, sound effects, one weight); Patrick Hand does all the reading. The page is readable with nothing running: every piece of motion is a one-time arrival tween on content that is already visible, and reduced-motion users get the whole book still.

The world was chosen over, and explicitly rejects, the dark cinematic studio portfolio, a Stranger Things variant, paper and serif document worlds, and bento widget grids. Panels never tilt or rotate; tilt belongs to captions, sound effects and stickers.
keyCharacteristics: Cream halftone ground (0.8px ink dots on a 7px grid) under white panels with 4px ink borders and 8px hard offset shadows.
One signal colour (pink) for the title, the masthead, the live chapter, progress, focus and selection; four more flat comic colours rotate one-per-panel.
Bangers at 400 for every display role, Patrick Hand at 400 for every reading role; outlined pink lettering for the two biggest headings.
Square corners everywhere except speech bubbles (1.5rem) and the three circles (badge, year, avatar).
Press-and-lift motion: buttons press into their shadow on hover, covers and the resume sheet lift away from theirs.
Arrival choreography only (GSAP `from` tweens, `once`, cleared after), on content that is never pre-hidden.

rules.name: The One Accent Per Panel Rule
rules.body: A panel carries one comic colour for its lettering (stat, sound effect, file headline, group title, power-up tab), chosen by its index in the five-colour rotation. Pink is the signal for the issue as a whole; teal and amber additionally hold two fixed roles (the promoted caption; the burst and badge stickers) and both appear inside the inked spot art.

rules.name: The Ink Is Ink Rule
rules.body: Every border, shadow, stroke and body glyph is #111. There is no tinted border, no grey line, no coloured shadow except pink on an interactive target.

rules.name: The Pink Means Live Rule
rules.body: A pink offset shadow always marks something you can act on: every button at rest, the resume sheet, a hovered case file, a hovered back-issue cover. The reverse does not hold: resting case files, back-issue covers and the chapters button cast ink and only turn pink, or press, when touched.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Both faces load at 400 only. Hierarchy comes from size, colour, stroke and the Bangers/Patrick Hand switch, never from weight. Where the build asks for 700 today the browser fakes it; that is a defect to remove, not a device to reuse.

rules.name: The Outlined Shout Rule
rules.body: Pink fill with a 2px ink text-stroke is reserved for the cover title and the back-cover headline; stats and sound effects use their panel accent with the stroke.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are solid ink or pink, offset down-right, zero blur, zero spread. A soft shadow is not in this world.

rules.name: The Press And Lift Rule
rules.body: Buttons press: `translate(2px, 2px)` with the shadow shrinking by the same amount, over 0.12s. Cards lift: the resume sheet and back-issue covers move `-3px`/`-2px` with the shadow growing, over 0.15s to 0.18s. Case files grow their shadow without moving.

dos: Do draw every surface with an ink border (4px for panels, 3px for controls, 2px for tags) and a hard offset shadow; the offset is the elevation.
Do give each panel exactly one comic colour from the five-colour rotation, and keep pink for the signals the whole issue shares (title, masthead, progress, focus, selection, live shadows).
Do set every display role in Bangers at 400 and every reading role in Patrick Hand at 400; emphasise with the yellow highlighter stripe or a pink fill with an ink stroke.
Do knock running text out of the halftone with a cream background (`.lede`) when it sits directly on the stock.

Do animate with `gsap.from`, triggered once on arrival with transforms cleared afterwards, so the page reads correctly with nothing running; gate every script and transition on `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do press buttons into their shadow on hover and lift covers and sheets away from theirs.
Do put tilt on captions (−1°), sound effects (−8°) and stickers; keep panels, tiles, bubbles and buttons square to the page.
donts: Don't tilt, rotate or skew a panel, at rest or in its arrival tween.
Don't pre-hide content for an entrance animation; opacity and transform start at the resting state and only the tween departs from it.
Don't use a blurred, spread or tinted shadow; shadows are solid ink or solid pink at an integer offset.
Don't use a radius on a UI surface that is not a speech bubble or a circle (badge, year, avatar); illustration (calendar cells, spot-art stickers) may round its own corners.

Don't introduce a grey, a gradient fill, or a tinted border; the only grey is `ink-muted` on secondary text, and the only gradients are hard-stop: the halftone dots, the dashed spine, the zig-zag band and the highlighter stripe.
Don't bring the dark studio, paper-document or bento-grid worlds back in any surface; the comic is the site.
